advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Render the two invalid-ticket-type error messages from _TYPES (e.g. ', '.join(_TYPES)) instead of hand-copying the vocabulary.
evidence: src/rebar/_commands/composer.py:165: "Must be one of: bug, epic, story, task, session_log, code_review, identity",
src/rebar/_commands/composer.py:635: "Must be one of: bug, epic, story, task, session_log, code_review, identity"
The commit's stated intent: 'A type added to TicketType but missed here is rejected at create' — after this change validation accepts a new type but the error message would omit it.
advisory.finding: The invalid-ticket-type error messages still hard-code the type list ('Must be one of: bug, epic, story, task, session_log, code_review, identity') at two sites, so they remain hand-copies that will drift when a type is added to TicketType — the same class of defect this change eliminates from validation and the usage line.
advisory.suggested_fix: Replace the literal 'Must be one of: bug, epic, ...' strings at composer.py:165 and :635 with f"Must be one of: {', '.join(_TYPES)}".

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Replace the inspect.getsource string-absence check with a behavioral assertion (e.g. that create validation derives from TicketType).
evidence: ABSENCE rationale: the assertion targets the module's SOURCE TEXT, not any observable behavior; it would break on a behavior-preserving change (e.g. the literal appearing in a docstring, comment, or example) and would pass even if a hardcoded list were re-introduced under different quoting/spacing.
advisory.finding: test_the_module_no_longer_lists_the_types is a source-grepping change-detector: it reads the source of the unit under test via inspect.getsource(composer) and asserts a string literal is absent, testing the implementation text rather than behavior.
scenarios: A future refactor mentions the tuple values in a docstring/comment — test fails with no behavior change.
A regression re-lists the types with single quotes or different spacing — test passes despite the drift returning.
advisory.suggested_fix: Drop the source-grep; rely on the identity assertion `composer._TYPES is TICKET_TYPES` (or `==`) plus a behavioral create test to guard single-sourcing.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a create-path test that a valid TicketType member is accepted and an unknown type raises the invalid_ticket_type CommandError.
evidence: src/rebar/_commands/composer.py:162: `if ticket_type not in _TYPES:` — the real create-time rejection path is never exercised by this test.

ABSENCE rationale: because `_TYPES == get_args(TicketType)`, the subtraction is arithmetic over the same value; inverting the production behavior (create using a stale hard-coded list) would leave this test green since it only inspects `_TYPES`, never a create() call.
src/rebar/_commands/composer.py:162-168: raises `CommandError(... error_code="invalid_ticket_type" ...)` for `ticket_type not in _TYPES`
src/rebar/_commands/composer.py:632-636: second validation site (`if value not in _TYPES:`) with its own message string.

ABSENCE rationale: the added behavior includes rejecting a named violating input 'not-a-type' at create; no test drives create() with that input to assert the raised CommandError/error_code, so the observable rejection path is untested.
advisory.finding: test_a_type_added_to_ticket_type_becomes_creatable (AC3) is a convergent/tautological test: it re-derives the expected set from get_args(TicketType) and subtracts composer._TYPES, which equals get_args(TicketType), instead of driving the actual create validation path. It cannot detect a regression where create validation stops honoring TicketType.
merged_from: No test exercises composer's observable create-time validation contract: that an unknown ticket type raises CommandError with error_code 'invalid_ticket_type' (composer.py:162 and :632). test_an_unknown_type_is_still_rejected only checks membership in the internal _TYPES tuple, not the rejection behavior.
scenarios: A regression reintroduces a hardcoded list at the actual validation site while _TYPES stays derived — this test still passes.
The headline bug ('newly added type is REJECTED at create') recurs at the call path — undetected.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test that invokes the create composition (or the validation helper) with a valid type asserting success, and with an unknown type asserting CommandError(error_code='invalid_ticket_type').
